## Why

Goal 8 and the acceptance criterion: lint catches each defect class, with a
fixture test for each.

## Files

## Failing tests

One fixture store and one test per defect class:
- missing required fields;
- dangling links (`supersedes`, `superseded_by` pointing at missing IDs);
- supersede cycles;
- two accepted decisions on the same `key`;
- missing `decided_by` on a decided record (a warning, per C18 as recommended).
A clean fixture store exits 0.
